Captain Aaron M Powell is a commissioned Military Intelligence Officer in the Kansas Army National Guard. CPT Powell currently drills with the 35th Infantry Division Headquarters in Leavenworth, Kansas.

CPT Powell enlisted in the Nebraska Army National Guard on 27 May 2011 at age 19. He completed Basic Combat Training and Advanced Individual Training then served as an 88M Equipment Operator with the 1075th Transportation Detachment in York, Nebraska, until commissioning on 6 May 2016. Upon commissioning he served as a Field Artillery Officer with 1/129 Field Artillery in Maryvile, Missouri then transferred to Military Intelligence with the 35th Infantry Division. Before his current assignment, he returned to Kearney, Nebraska and served as an Intel Advisor for the 734th Combat Sustainment Battalion.

CPT Powell attended the University of Nebraska at Lincoln from January 2012 to May 2016, earning academic merit scholarships and a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration specializing in Finance and Accounting. He is currently enrolled at Southern Methodist University pursuing a Master's of Science in Data Science. 

CPT Powell is a broker registered by the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) in 53 U.S. states and territories. He is an expert in equities trading, options trading, market analysis, and educating retail investors in retirement and estate planning, portfolio management, and investment strategies.

In 2022, CPT Powell deployed to Kuwait, Qatar, and Jordan in support of multiple operations.

CPT Powell is a recipient of the Army Meritorious Service Medal and the Army Commendation Medal.

CPT Powell's previous assignments include Division Intel Plans Officer, Battalion Intel Advisor, Division Intel Targeting Officer, Battle Captain, Intel Section Chief, Aide-de-camp for BG(ret) Fujimoto, Battery Executive Officer, Fire Support Officer, Fire Direction Officer and Platoon leader. 

CPT Powell maintains active membership in several professional and charitable organizations, including Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 3113, American Legion post 180, Truman Chapter of the U.S. Field Artillery Association, the Association of the United States Army, the University of Nebraska Alumni Association, Delta Upsilon Nebraska Chapter, Beta Alpha Psi – Delta Omicron Chapter, the Association of Government Accountants, Wounded Warrior Project (Ambassador), Eight Days of Hope Disaster Relief, and Habitat for Humanity.
